rule: A candidate is eliminated only when historical evidence (including the user-provided historical attributes) contradicts it. Reproducing the metadata does not prove a candidate.
historical_constraints_used: file UID 0, GID 1001, mode 0644, size 209306, SHA-256 dd0ff1… (user-provided)
observed Python process PID 325 running as UID/GID 1000 (user-provided)
ZIP entries carry no UID/GID fields and no extra fields (T11 CONFIRMED; R03)

candidates.sequence: Root extraction (unzip / zipfile) into a setgid GID-1001 directory
supporting: Reproduces UID 0 / GID 1001 / 0644 and the parent state experimentally (T9 A/root, T10 S1a/S1c/S3a/S3c/S4a/S4b, T11 01/02/03 A/root)
candidates.would_discriminate: Historical mtime equal to a DOS time (2026-11-23T08:07:56Z or 07:21:58Z, or the same instant shifted by the extractor's TZ offset), with zero nanoseconds and ctime later than mtime, points to an mtime-restoring extractor (Info-ZIP unzip). A nanosecond mtime equal to ctime points to zipfile or a stream write.

candidates.sequence: Root copy (cp, install, shutil.copyfile/copy2, redirection) into a setgid GID-1001 directory
supporting: Reproduces the signature experimentally (T10 S5a/S5d/S5e/S5f; T11 04/06/07/08 A/root)
candidates.would_discriminate: copy2 and cp -p carry the source mtime to the nanosecond, while cp, copyfile and redirection stamp a new mtime equal to ctime. Recovering the source file's metadata would be needed.

candidates.sequence: Unprivileged extraction or copy, followed by explicit root chown (and chown/chmod of directories)
supporting: Reproduces the signature experimentally (T10 S6a, S6b)
A UID-1000 process (PID 325) existed in the historical namespace (user-provided); this shows an unprivileged actor was present but not that it acted on the file
candidates.would_discriminate: A ctime later than mtime by the gap between creation and chown, plus a root chown/fchownat in audit records.

candidates.sequence: Temporary file then rename(2) into place (temp in a setgid GID-1001 directory, or explicit ownership change before or after rename)
supporting: Reproduces the signature experimentally (T10 S6e; T11 09, 10g, 11a A/root)
candidates.would_discriminate: A rename leaves the inode and mtime unchanged and updates ctime. A temp file in a non-setgid directory keeps its own group (T11 10/11b), which conflicts with GID 1001 unless the group was explicitly changed.

candidates.sequence: Other: a privileged platform materialisation service (for example a connector or file-upload helper running as root) writing into the setgid directory
candidates.note: Mechanically this is a case of C1, C2 or C4. No historical record of any such process was recoverable, so it is neither supported nor excluded.

source_artifact_dimension.question: Which archive supplied the historical bytes?
source_artifact_dimension.note: Both archives contain byte-identical members (R07). A historical download record or archive hash, or an mtime restored from one of the two DOS times, would decide between them.

eliminated_variants.variant: Creation by an unprivileged identity with no later ownership change
eliminated_variants.contradiction: historical file UID 0; unprivileged creation yields the creator's UID (T9-T11)

eliminated_variants.variant: Direct creation of the PNG by the observed PID 325 (UID 1000) under ordinary credentials
eliminated_variants.contradiction: historical UID 0; an unprivileged process can neither create a UID-0 file nor chown it to 0
eliminated_variants.caveat: PID 325's capabilities and user-namespace mapping are unknown; with CAP_CHOWN or an idmapped namespace this would not hold
eliminated_variants.status: RULED OUT under ordinary credential semantics

eliminated_variants.variant: Root creation in a non-setgid parent with no group change
eliminated_variants.contradiction: file would have GID 0 (T10 S1b/S3b; T11 profile C root)

eliminated_variants.variant: cp -p (or any ownership-preserving copy) from a source not owned 0:1001
eliminated_variants.contradiction: preserves the source owner (T10 S5b/S5c; T11 05)

eliminated_variants.variant: Rename of a temp file created in a non-setgid directory, with no ownership change
Ownership restored from the archive (unzip -X or similar)
eliminated_variants.contradiction: no UID/GID or extra fields in either matching archive's member entry (R03; T11)

eliminated_variants.variant: Extraction with umask 002 that also created gh_demo
eliminated_variants.status: RULED OUT (only for the case where extraction created gh_demo)
